outgoing.name: Chernobyl disaster
outgoing.excerpt: In 1986, the Keurusselkä region was heavily contaminated (70 kBq/m²) by radioactive caesium ( 137Cs) from the Chernobyl disaster fallout.

outgoing.name: Finland
outgoing.excerpt: Keurusselkä is a lake in Central Finland between the towns of Keuruu to the north and Mänttä to the south.
